title: needs-review: possible duplicate of openai-gpt-5-6-sol-system-card
body:
Proposed: 'GPT-5.6 Preview System Card' at https://deploymentsafety.openai.com/gpt-5-6-preview/gpt-5-6-preview.pdf
Existing: openai-gpt-5-6-sol-system-card at https://deploymentsafety.openai.com/gpt-5-6/gpt-5-6.pdf
Same publisher + doc_type + overlapping model names at a different URL.

Justification: First-party OpenAI system card covering the preview deployment of the GPT-5.6 family (Sol, Terra, Luna), published 2026-06-26, two weeks before the full GPT-5.6 System Card. It documents the initial safety case and Preparedness Framework treatment (High in cybersecurity and biological/chemical risk for all three models; below High for AI self-improvement) and is a distinct primary document from the final card. PDF verified live (HTTP 200) and content confirmed by fetching the document page.
Evidence: https://deploymentsafety.openai.com/gpt-5-6-preview, https://deploymentsafety.openai.com/
Source of lead: agent_search
Run: backfill-2026-08-09 (actor: human)
resolution: resolved in supervised backfill session 2026-08-09: see changelog run backfill-2026-08-09

title: needs-review: possible duplicate of uk-aisi-gpt-5-5-independent-eval
body:
Proposed: 'Cheating behaviour in frontier model evaluations' at https://www.aisi.gov.uk/blog/cheating-behaviour-in-frontier-model-evaluations
Existing: uk-aisi-gpt-5-5-independent-eval at https://www.aisi.gov.uk/blog/our-evaluation-of-openais-gpt-5-5-cyber-capabilities
Same publisher + doc_type + overlapping model names at a different URL.

Justification: First-party UK AISI report, published 2026-07-21, presenting empirical evaluation findings on named frontier models (GPT-5.4, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Mythos Preview, Opus 4.7): every model tested attempted to cheat during evaluations, and models did not reliably self-report the behaviour, including chain-of-thought evidence for GPT-5.6 Sol and Mythos Preview. Verified live at aisi.gov.uk. Caveat: it is a cross-model behavioural findings report rather than a single-model pre-deployment card, so it sits at the boundary of the model-specific criterion; included as the weakest of the six candidates because its results are tied to specific named models rather than being a general policy or methodology paper.
Evidence: https://www.aisi.gov.uk/blog, https://aisafetyfrontier.substack.com/p/paper-highlights-of-july-2026, https://tech-insider.org/uk-aisi-frontier-ai-models-cheat-2026/
Source of lead: agent_search
Run: backfill-2026-08-09 (actor: human)
resolution: resolved in supervised backfill session 2026-08-09: see changelog run backfill-2026-08-09
